subject: Trial scope & kickoff — proposed plan and success criteria (Northbridge)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@northbridge.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Next steps after demo — trial scope & success metrics

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the model throughput and the latency numbers looked promising. The analytics team asked me to send a short summary of what we need for a 3-week trial so we can get procurement and infra lined up. High level requests from our side: 

- Short POC (2–3 weeks) focused on ingest -> embeddings -> rerank for our document search workflow.
- Success criteria: recall @10 >= 0.78 on our eval set, median response latency < 400ms for 90th percentile traffic, and total inference cost under $Xk (TBD after you share config).
- Data: we'll provide a 50k-document fragment of internal docs (PII scrubbed) and a small eval set (200 queries + ground truth).
- Technical contact: Tom Nguyen (cc'd) will coordinate infra/procurement.

Two asks before we can kick off: a concise POC plan (owners, infra footprint, timeline, required credentials/access), and the standard NDA / SSO details for private endpoints. Can you send something we can attach to the internal ticket?

Elena
Head of Data Science
Northbridge Analytics

Attachment: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@northbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo — trial scope & success metrics

Hi Elena / Tom —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a 1-page POC plan and an evaluation checklist that maps to the success criteria you listed. Summary below with owners and a proposed schedule: 

POC scope (2.5 weeks, recommended):
- Week 0 (prep, 2 business days): NDA/contract sign, SFTP for scrubbed docs, customer to share eval set. Owner: Marissa (commercial) + Tom (northbridge infra).
- Week 1 (integration, 3 business days): Ingest + embeddings pipeline validation, baseline recall. Owner: Vivek (eng lead).
- Week 2 (tuning & rerank, 4 business days): Model/quantization config sweep, cache warm-up, reranking evaluation. Owner: Vivek + Northbridge data science.
- Week 2.5 (validation & handoff, 3 business days): Final metrics, runbook, and notes for production handoff. Owner: Marissa (CS coord).

Success criteria (measurable):
- Recall@10 >= 0.78 on your eval set (we'll run the initial baseline and iterate);
- Median response latency (90th percentile) <= 400ms for the configured traffic profile;
- End-to-end integration with your S3/SFTP for document pulls and a stable embeddings pipeline;
- Cost cap: we will provide an estimate for the proposed config within 24 hours after we confirm batch sizes and model variant.

Infrastructure and access needed:
- One staging AWS VPC peered or temporary SFTP access (details in attached POC plan);
- Service account with read access to the eval S3 keys (short-lived);
- Optional: If you prefer, we can run the trial on Redwood Dedicated capacity for isolation — Marissa can provide pricing.

Attachments: NB-POC-Plan-v1.pdf (1-page plan), evaluation-checklist.xlsx (CSV-style checklist).

Next steps:
1) Marissa to send a procurement packet/quote and confirm Dedicated vs hosted trial.
2) Elena/Tom to confirm kickoff window (we suggested next week, earliest Tue 17 Nov).
3) Sign NDA if not already done; I've attached the standard NDA link and noted we can accept your signed copy.

If Tom or Elena prefer a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow morning to lock the kickoff, I'm happy to join.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Attachments: NB-POC-Plan-v1.pdf (application/pdf), evaluation-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@northbridge.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:55:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo — trial scope & success metrics

Elena / Vivek —

Quick commercial note: for a 3-week trial we usually include a pilot credit that covers egress + base token usage; if you opt for Dedicated capacity there's a standard one-month reservation minimum, but we can offer a pilot price that makes it cost-neutral for the trial. I'll attach the procurement packet and a rough quote in a separate thread to Tom.

Also looping in the standard SSO checklist: can you confirm if you want SSO for the console or just API keys for the trial? For speed, API keys + scoped service account works best.

I can coordinate procurement conversations with Tom — Tom, can you confirm who at Northbridge owns procurement approvals and an internal ticket number if available?

—Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none (procurement packet to follow)
